note: Held-out validation set, fixed before placement v5 was written or run (October 21, 2026). None of these cases was used to design v4 or v5. Known-filled pairings come from established literatures with published reviews. Known-empty pairings are ones a 2022-2025 management article claims to be the first to study (OpenAlex ID of that article given). Idea texts are one-line paraphrases written for this test.

cases.idea: Do firms appoint directors who link them to the providers of resources they depend on, as resource dependence theory proposes?
cases.basis: resource dependence and boards (Hillman, Withers, and Collins 2009 review)

cases.idea: Does the loss of personal resources, as conservation of resources theory describes, drive employee burnout?
cases.basis: conservation of resources and burnout (Hobfoll et al. 2018 review)

cases.idea: Does satisfying employees' needs for autonomy, competence, and relatedness, as self-determination theory proposes, raise their work motivation?
cases.basis: self-determination theory and work motivation (Gagne and Deci 2005)

cases.idea: Does a firm's absorptive capacity, its ability to recognize and use outside knowledge, raise its innovation?
cases.basis: absorptive capacity and innovation (Cohen and Levinthal 1990 onward)

cases.idea: Do large pay gaps between the CEO and other executives act as tournament prizes that motivate executives, as tournament theory proposes?
cases.basis: tournament theory and executive pay (Connelly et al. 2014 review)

cases.idea: Does groupthink lead cohesive teams to make poor decisions?
Does trust between partner firms shape how strategic alliances are governed?
Does embeddedness in close interfirm ties improve firms' performance?
Do employees judge their pay against others' pay, as equity theory proposes, so that perceived inequity lowers their pay satisfaction?
cases.basis: equity theory and pay satisfaction (Adams 1965 onward)

cases.idea: Does population density, as organizational ecology proposes, shape the rates at which organizations are founded and fail?
cases.basis: density dependence in organizational ecology (Hannan and Freeman 1989 onward)

cases.idea: Does employees' regulatory focus shape how being overqualified for their jobs affects their intention to leave?
Do employees who work with learning algorithms craft their jobs, as job crafting theory proposes, to reshape their experience of work?
Does incomplete contracting theory explain how business angels' ownership affects the transaction costs of the firms they invest in?
Does empowering leadership raise worker productivity through a stimulus-organism-response process?
Are people's perceptions of organizational greed shaped by motivated reasoning?
Does construal level theory explain how family firms pursue digital product innovation?
Does secularization shape the values that guide how family firms do business?
Does structural equivalence explain the structure of supply networks, with firms in similar network positions behaving alike?
